week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 8.5 percentage points apart on Buffalo at Minnesota.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 12.8 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Cleveland's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 33%. Jacksonville is the Super Bowl favorite at 12%.
